label: 2026-10-14-lean
finalMessage:
I've added the three Claude 5.5 models to `src/prices.js` and a test that costs one request on each. All 17 tests pass with `npm test`, up from 16. The three existing entries are unchanged, and I haven't committed anything.

| Model | input | output | cacheRead | cacheWrite (5m) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `claude-haiku-5-5` (prompts up to 100,000 tokens) | 0.1 | 0.5 | 0.01 | 0.125 |
| `claude-sonnet-5-5` | 2 | 10 | **0.1** | 2.5 |
| `claude-opus-5-5` | 4 | 20 | 0.2 | 5 |

**Sonnet 5.5's cache-read price is the one that changed recently.** The Sonnet 5.5 launch page (Sept 28) still says $0.20, but Anthropic's release notes for Oct 7, 2026 say it was cut to $0.10. That was the price on 2026-10-13, and no price changes are listed between Oct 7 and Oct 13. The new test uses a non-zero cache-read count, so it fails if anyone puts back $0.20.

The pricing page, the Haiku 5.5 model page and claude.com/pricing all list the same numbers.

**Changes:**
- **`src/prices.js:3-12`:** new comment line with the source URL, the "Last updated" line changed to 2026-10-13, and the three new entries.
- **`test/cost.test.js:12`:** a new test that costs one request on each 5.5 model. The prompt is 60,000 tokens, safely under Haiku 5.5's 100,000-token threshold.

**One limitation:** Haiku 5.5 charges 5x more on every component when a prompt is over 100,000 tokens, counting cache reads and writes. `costOf` has no tiers, so it will undercharge those requests. I noted this in a comment on the entry. Fixing it would mean passing the prompt length into `getPrice`.

Sources:
- [Pricing – Claude Platform Docs](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing) (the URL in the file comment)
- [Release notes](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview) (Sonnet 5.5 cache-read cut on Oct 7, 2026)
- [Claude Haiku 5.5 model page](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/haiku-5-5/overview)
- [claude.com/pricing](https://claude.com/pricing)
- [Claude Sonnet 5.5 launch page](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-sonnet-5-5) and [Claude Opus 5.5 launch page](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-opus-5-5)
